note:
The web-facing version of the work history. The resume JSON stays the source of every FACT; this file decides which single claim leads for each role and how it is said. Nothing here may state a figure that is not in resume.json.

Rules: one claim per role. One figure, not five. Second person first, first person second. Short closed sentences. The detail exists for anyone who wants it and for search engines, but it is not the surface.

roles.label: Static analysis
roles.you: Your build is broken across eight repositories.

figure.caption: compile errors cleared in a single pull request

roles.detail: A .NET 8 Roslyn platform: a solution-wide extraction engine, an architecture-metrics engine with Tarjan cycle detection, a 60-route API, and a 37-component Blazor dashboard written solo. Dead-code detection went from roughly 5% accurate to 96.9%, and the cycle scanner from 88% false positives to none across 457 projects.

roles.label: Attribution
roles.you: You were paying for ads that looked like they failed.

figure.caption: of in-window payments were missing from conversion reporting

roles.detail: The Google Ads and TikTok uploaders were selecting contacts by signup date instead of payment date, so returning patients who paid inside the window were silently dropped. I wrote the payment-date scanner that became the shared source of truth, then hardened the recovery path: deterministic order IDs, window-invariant revenue keying, UTC-consistent scoping, and guards for test mode and future dates.

roles.label: AI services
roles.you: Your analysts spend the afternoon assembling what they already know.

figure.caption: faster than the manual build it replaced, in production

roles.detail: A FastAPI and LangChain service that reads markdown from upstream bots and lays out positioned dashboards. 100 of 115 commits, 18,040 lines across 94 files, containerised and deployed to AWS in six weeks at pylint 10/10 with zero SonarQube issues and 379 tests. Also seven production LangGraph subagents on the onboarding AI.

roles.label: Computer vision
roles.you: A script your grandparents could not read either.
roles.me: I taught a camera to read it.

figure.caption: webcam, reading handwriting in real time

roles.detail: Handwritten Baybayin recognised live using Python and OpenCV, with Lucas-Kanade optical flow and KLT tracking feeding a GRU recurrent network, wrapped in a Tkinter interface. The version above is the browser-sized half of the same problem: no model, no download, and template matching against glyphs rendered from the page font.

roles.label: Onboarding
roles.you: A new hire cannot find what the company already knows.
roles.me: So I made the company answer them.

figure.caption: chatbot, replacing a manual search through years of posts

roles.detail: An on-premise retrieval chatbot over the company's Redmine data, built with SQLite, LangChain, Ollama and ChromaDB. It replaced a workflow of searching old posts by hand and re-posting the answer.

figure.caption: developers, one point of contact, shipped on time
